title: QR code generation

requirements.text: Data encodes to a valid ISO/IEC 18004 symbol (all versions and error-correction levels) that standard readers decode
The smallest fitting version and the lowest-penalty mask are chosen automatically
Data that cannot fit is refused with a clear error instead of a corrupt symbol
Output is a scalable SVG (or sized PNG) with a quiet zone of at least four modules
SVG output escapes caller text (title) and refuses unsafe color values
The rendered code has a text alternative, and the encoded link or text is also shown or available

evidence.name: matrix matches segno byte for byte
auto mask is the lowest-penalty mask
too much data fails with too-long
SVG has one merged path, viewBox and size
SVG rejects unsafe colors and escapes the title

implementations.notes: Matrices match an independent encoder (segno 1.6.6) byte for byte; no physical reader scan was run. The SVG carries role=img and a title, but showing the encoded text is the app's job.
External MIT React/React Native SVG renderer

notes: module:qr-code covers encoding and safe SVG output; the accessible requirement (text alternative plus the visible link) stays with the app.
